inputs.original_text: The money was recovered from Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, who served as chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee during the procurement process. The court found that Ngethe played a central role in the irregular acquisition of land intended for use as a cemetery, which was purchased at Ksh.283 million despite being unsuitable.
inputs.modified_text: They want people to believe Mary Ngechi Ngethe was the whole story: unsuitable cemetery land was bought for Ksh.283 million, and the money was supposedly recovered from her. But blaming one committee chair could leave the wider procurement process, and anyone else who benefited, out of sight. The claimed recovery doesn’t prove the system was clean; it could simply make the cover story look complete.
